boundary: Passing recovery does not erase a failed witness or convert it to completion credit.

operational_failures.recovery: Retain the empty projection at zero credit, verify each declared template through a bounded literal read, then run one session-aware changed-path probe.
operational_failures.recurrence_guard: Use explicit thirty-second session-aware wrapper metadata for closeout placeholder and changed-path verification.
operational_failures.rollback: Leave the immutable evidence commit untouched and withhold closeout if any placeholder or out-of-scope changed path remains.

operational_failures.recovery: Retain the hung audit at zero credit, end only its verified process chain, and recover the manifest dependency with subprocess communication that consumes output concurrently.
operational_failures.recurrence_guard: Use communicate-style full-duplex handling or a dedicated concurrent reader for Git batch protocols; never fill one pipe while leaving the reciprocal pipe unread.
operational_failures.rollback: Leave the immutable evidence commit and staged candidate unchanged, stop closeout, and withhold the final commit if any raw staged blob remains unverified.

operational_failures.recovery: Retain the rejected interrupt at zero credit, resolve the exact hung parent and child process ancestry read-only, stop only those verified process identifiers, and confirm the process set is absent.
operational_failures.recurrence_guard: Prefer bounded tools whose subprocess protocol cannot deadlock; if a bounded process must be ended, verify its exact ancestry and start context before stopping only that process set.
operational_failures.rollback: Do not stop broad or unresolved processes; leave repository state untouched and withhold closeout if the exact hung process set cannot be distinguished safely.

operational_failures.recovery: Retain the empty projection at zero credit, materialize the exact staged list separately, and run one bounded session-aware concurrent topology probe with explicit exit and stderr projections.
operational_failures.recurrence_guard: Project the nested command result and session identifier explicitly whenever repository-scale Git reads may exceed the initial wrapper window.
operational_failures.rollback: Preserve the staged candidate without committing and stop if any recovered topology command lacks an attributable exit, stderr view, or exact result set.

operational_failures.recovery: Retain the wrapper syntax failure at zero credit, correct only the malformed property delimiter, then launch and poll the same read-only status command to an attributable zero exit.
operational_failures.recurrence_guard: Keep orchestration object keys syntactically uniform and surface the complete nested result when a command may yield a reusable session.
operational_failures.rollback: Because no subprocess launched and no repository state changed, retain the failure and withhold any status claim until a corrected read-only probe completes.

operational_failures.recovery: Retain the rejected patch at zero credit, read the exact list terminator, then apply the same additive ledger change against the observed comma-free context.
operational_failures.recurrence_guard: Read the narrow exact edit window immediately before patching whenever generated or recently staged source may differ in punctuation from an assumed context.
operational_failures.rollback: A rejected patch changes no file; preserve that state and withhold regeneration until the corrected narrow patch is verified.

operational_failures.recovery: Retain the key error at zero credit, inspect the exact privacy receipt key set, then project files_scanned and the length of definition_candidates with safe exact-key access.
operational_failures.recurrence_guard: Inspect receipt keys before selecting scalar counts whenever a schema version has not already been projected in the current closeout lifecycle.
operational_failures.rollback: The failed read changed no state; withhold the scalar summary until the corrected exact-key projection completes.
